headline: Bank of Korea Expects Strong Growth Supported by Semiconductor Boom
summary: The Bank of Korea stated that South Korea's economy is expected to sustain strong growth above previous forecasts, driven by the semiconductor boom despite Middle East uncertainties.
why: The Bank of Korea is the central bank of South Korea, tasked with maintaining monetary and financial stability.

impacts.name: South Korean Semiconductors
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected economic forecasts supported by a semiconductor boom provide positive momentum for domestic chip manufacturers.
